info.name: Thrive Global Partner audio experiences content API

description.content:
API for accessing Thrive Global content and features. All content endpoints require a Bearer token obtained via the authentication endpoint.

Response envelopes follow the pattern `{ message, valid, data }` where `data` contains the response payload. Collection endpoints nest items at a resource-specific path (e.g. `data.data.reset.thrive.get.items`).
